org: House2Home Nashville (demo configuration based on their public accept/decline list; synthetic, not affiliated)

mattress.reason: Used mattresses are not accepted; every client gets a new bed.
mattress.alternative: Mattress recycling drop-off (check Metro Nashville convenience centers).

bed_frame.reason: Used bed frames and bed parts are not accepted.

sleeper_sofa.reason: Sleeper sofas are not accepted (too heavy for volunteer crews, mechanisms fail).
sleeper_sofa.alternative: Habitat for Humanity ReStore or a local resale group.

bedding.reason: Only brand-new bedding is accepted; confirm it is still in its package.

tv_stand.reason: Entertainment centers and TV stands are not accepted.
tv_stand.alternative: Habitat for Humanity ReStore or a thrift store.

tv.reason: TVs and outdated electronics are not accepted.
tv.alternative: Electronics recycling (check Metro Nashville convenience centers).

electronics.alternative: Electronics recycling (check Metro Nashville convenience centers).

curtains.alternative: Goodwill or another thrift donation center.

clothing.alternative: Goodwill or another thrift donation center.

medical.reason: Medical supplies and equipment are not accepted.

desk.reason: Desks are taken only when small and currently needed; a volunteer checks size and demand.

wardrobe.reason: Wardrobes are taken only when small and currently needed; a volunteer checks size and demand.

sectional.reason: Sectionals may not fit client apartments or the truck; a volunteer checks size.

other.reason: The item type is not on the standard list; a volunteer decides.
